description: LLM-quality translation as a pay-per-call primitive: send text= (up to 6K characters) and to= any language, get only the translation back — no notes, no wrapper prose, safe to pipe straight into the next step. Priced by length: $0.03 to 2,000 characters, $0.08 above — the 402 challenge quotes the price for the text you sent. No API key or subscription. Built for agents localizing content, parsing foreign-language sources, or serving multilingual users.
